entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I think I need to return something? I bought some of your road cycling shoes, and I just don't think they're right.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear the shoes aren't working out. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I'm not sure. They just... they hurt my feet. I went for one ride and got terrible blisters. I tried moving the cleats around but it didn't help. I just want a refund, I think. The website was so confusing, I wasn't sure what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help you with that. Let me just pull up your order information. One moment.
Okay, I see your order for the cycling shoes. It looks like they were delivered 11 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Oh, okay. I hope it's not too late. I just got so overwhelmed.
Not at all. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date for a return. So you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Really? That's a relief. So... what do I do now?

It's very simple. I've just started the return process for you. I'm sending an email to you right now with a pre-paid shipping label. Just package the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, we'll process your refund right away.
Oh, thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
